title: should render the Powered by OpenObserve brand link twice (header + footer) on the public page
verifies: a published status page serves exactly two brand links, each anchored to https://openobserve.ai/ with target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer, the OpenObserve SVG mark, and the wordmark

title: should render the brand link twice (header + footer) in the editor live preview
verifies: the editor live preview renders exactly two brand links with safe new-tab attributes

title: should distinguish header and footer brand links by scope on the public page
verifies: the public shell has one brand link in the header region and one in the footer region

title: should return 404 for a draft status page (no public shell, no brand link)
verifies: an unpublished (draft) status page returns 404 so the brand link is absent until publication

title: should render the brand link on a just-published page before the first snapshot builds
verifies: a just-published (unbuilt) page still renders the static brand link without waiting for the snapshot
